name: Coconut palm, young (our own design)
about: Made by tools/battle-models/asia (scenery). Metres; x east, y right, z up from the ground at its foot. Stands still: `sway` (0 to 1, point by point) is how far the wind moves each point; nothing else moves. Looks only: the battle's ground decides cover and passage. Paints: 0 bark, 1 bark_dark, 2 frond, 3 frond_light, 4 frond_dry, 5 nut
